category_edits.rationale: Refine the existing cosine schedule to decay smoothly after each optimizer update, reaching 10% of the initial learning rate at the epoch cap. Preserve Adam, batch size, dropout, weight decay, early stopping, validation cadence, model, loss and prediction.

change_summary: Apply cosine learning-rate decay per optimizer update across all four category models; retain the existing 200-epoch default and single-model routing.
